page.overview:
Who is Zanita Cobral?

Zanita Cobral was the true leader of the Cobral family and the mother of Rutin, Solan, and Bard Cobral. She committed suicide in 40 BBY after failing to assassinate her daughter-in-law, Lena Cobral, who had testified before the Galactic Senate earlier that day.
